intent: A cool stone-pale quarryman's set under one hugely wide dark timber carrying yoke bound in rusted iron, with a thick slate goggle band, a dust mask, a wide rope strap and a thigh mallet; at the high camera the pale mass reads as quarried stone, barred by the yoke.
reason: Block-carrier: a wooden carrying yoke across the shoulders, the strongest outline of the run and unmistakable from the ARPG camera, over a dust-masked, hand-wrapped quarryman (second critic 7.5, first; first critic 6.15, fourth).
first_fix: The body is iron-grey: warm it to dust white, hang clear loads (stone blocks, tools) from the yoke ends, and add one funerary sign.
